title: Responsible AI for General-Purpose Systems: Overview, Challenges, and A Path Forward

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative comparison of Type-1 (rule-based) and Type-2 (neural) machine translation systems using hypothetical gender-neutral prompts (e.g., translating Hungarian to English to observe stereotypical pronoun associations).

Qualitative analysis of abstractive summarization systems injecting opinion/preference bias, specifically evaluating how models might interject Western beauty norms and subjective framing compared to traditional extractive summarizers.

Qualitative use case analysis of question-answering systems to demonstrate disparagement, comparing fact-based retrieval systems against LLMs generating offensive or derogatory terms (e.g., 'gold diggers') based on wealth and marriage status.
